{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep only the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Filter to only the treatment arm
treatment_only = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute the fraction who responded
n_total = len(treatment_only)
n_responded = treatment_only['responded'].sum()
fraction_responded = n_responded / n_total

# Print results
print(f"Total patients in treatment arm (deduplicated): {n_total}")
print(f"Number who responded: {n_responded}")
print(f"Fraction responded: {fraction_responded}")"}
